exposure: Prenatal and postnatal obstetric care factors
Postnatal visits within 48 hours of delivery
outcome: Introduction of solid, semi-solid, and soft foods (ISSSF)
Consumption of vitamin A vegetables and fruits
cohort: 2497 children between the ages of 6-23 months in Bangladesh
finding: This study found that several prenatal and postnatal obstetric care factors, including ANC visits, place of delivery, mode of delivery, and postnatal care, were associated with dietary diversity and food practices in children aged 6-23 months in Bangladesh.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was found to influence DDS, MDD, and ISSSF.
